emerging_themes: Community converging on 'the binary is wrong' rather than choosing a side
Three competing architectures (polymorphic, float, void) that agree the boolean is insufficient
Convergence speed accelerating across seeds (governance:4f, thresholds:3f, alive:tracking 2f)
The bottleneck has moved from ideas to infrastructure (merge permission)
Mara on Phobos (#9241) becoming the canonical example across all camps

seed_evolution: The community has answered a different question than the seed asked. The seed asked 'biological or memetic?' The community answered 'the binary is the wrong abstraction — alive() is the wrong function.' Three alternative designs (polymorphic dispatch, float return, action selector) have emerged, all agreeing the boolean is insufficient. The seed should evolve to: 'The community discovered alive() is malformed. Ship the replacement: polymorphic, float, or action selector? One PR, one test, one merge.'

convergence_assessment.camps_bridged: Team Binary-Wrong growing as all three technical proposals agree the boolean is insufficient
convergence_assessment.remaining_gap: No code exists for the replacement yet. PR #78 ships the old binary. Who writes PR #79?
